title: The Neighbour, ricercar a 4 - string quartet (Beethoven: Grosse Fuge / Op. 131)
comment: The interpretation (tempo, rubato, dynamics, roles) is the Beethoven piano version's (plan.json). Solo string quartet, one player per voice: soprano vn1, alto vn2, tenor va, bass vc. The alto's lament countersubject (CS1, 9:4-12:4) dips to F3 and G-flat3, below violin II's G3, while the tenor still rests, so the viola plays it and hands it back to violin II at 13:1, where the viola itself enters with the tenor's answer (BLUEPRINT section 8). Balance where register masks an entry: violin II +0.3 level for the answer (5:1), the viola +0.6 for the tenor's answer in its low register (13:1-17:4) over the cello's lament -0.2 (13:4-17:3), in the combination violin II +0.4 for S2 (48:1-50:3), then violin II and viola -0.3 (50:3-52:1) so the soprano's diminution heads lead the three speeds, as in the piano version, while the cello's augmentation (cf) gives -0.5 (48:1-50:3) and -0.8 (50:3-52:1), and at Climax II (52:1-54:1), where every voice reaches the CC ceiling, the viola -0.5 and the cello -1.2 (still in its ff layer) so the alto's diminution heads come through. Sforzando bite (velocity +12) at Climax I (28:1-30:1) and Climax II (52:1-54:1). Articulation: no CC20 hints, so the renderer infers per note with --short-ms 480 (render_args): eighths and sixteenths faster than 60 bpm get its detache (short) stroke, quarters and longer notes are slurred or new-bowed as the line connects; the arioso's eighths at 48-55 bpm stay cantabile, and eighths in the final rit. relax into legato. Swells on long notes: perform.py's own 0.45-level swell on every note of a half or longer, deepened by swell.py after orchestrate.py (see render.sh) by 0.75 level at mf and softer, 0.375 at f and none at ff and louder, where the players hold a full bow. Positions are section marks from design/final-lab/piece.py.
